svg.text: BX-01 — THAN HOP, MAT BANG
Hop Mahjong 152 quan, BURLORA. Phu bi 370 x 374 x 65.
Sheet nay truoc day KHONG TON TAI — than hop chi co mat trong mot chuoi kich thuoc tren GA-02 (review Rev B §2.2).
MAT BANG — nhin tu tren, nap thao ra. TL 1:1
370 PHU BI X
374 PHU BI Y
B
C
A
B
CHU GIAI
Truc chot O6.20 +0,05/0 — X = 9 tu chuan B, doi xung hai ben.
7 mat mong dai 44, buoc 45, chuoi 314. Mat sam thuoc THAN, mat sang
thuoc NAP.
Go noi hoc am 120 rong x 12 nho ra, X 125..245, chay het chieu cao
vach.
Khe luon ngon nhac khay: hoc 70 x sau 6 vao vach truoc/sau.
Khoet xuyen mat dau khay 70 x cao 12 — mo moc ngon.
Hom ngon O25 sau 12, hai ben ranh Joker, khoet suot chieu sau.
4 o xuc xac 18 x 18 sau 12, vach 5.
Vach ngan 6, cao toi vanh tai chinh vi tri no.
Vach ban le 18 — bat buoc: chua ong go R9, thanh quanh lo 5.9 mm.
Hoc nam cham khoa nap 25.2 x 5.2 x sau 4.2, 8 cai tren than (va 8
doi ung tren nap). Vi tri +/-0,2.
CHUAN
A
MAT DAY NGOAI cua than (truoc khi dan chan dem). Chuan Z. Moi cao do
trong ho so deu do tu day, KHONG do tu vanh.
B
MAT NGOAI VACH BAN LE TRAI. Chuan X. Chon mat nay vi truc xoay ban
le cach no dung mot ban kinh ong go (9 mm) — do la kich thuoc kho
tinh nhat trong ca hop.
C
MAT NGOAI VACH TRUOC (mat vach goc, KHONG phai mat go noi cua hoc
am). Chuan Y. Go noi hoc am la chi tiet noi len, khong duoc lam
chuan.
